name: sift-it
title: Sift It
description: Search your files by what's in them: describe it or type exact words, and find documents, PDF pages, photos, screenshots, and moments in recordings and videos. On-device, with EmbeddingGemma 2.
author: jwa

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Files
commands.subtitle: Sift It
commands.description: Describe what you're looking for, or type exact words (in quotes to insist): documents, PDF pages, pictures, screenshots, and moments in recordings and videos, in one list with a preview for each.

commands.name: folders
commands.title: Manage Folders
commands.subtitle: Sift It
commands.description: Choose the folders Sift searches, download the model, and control background indexing.

commands.name: status
commands.title: Indexing Status
commands.subtitle: Sift It
commands.description: How indexing is going, in the menu bar.

preferences.name: siftPath
preferences.title: Engine
preferences.description: Path to the sift-it binary. Leave empty to use Homebrew's (brew install jwa91/tap/sift-it).

preferences.name: editor
preferences.title: Code Editor
preferences.description: Opens text and code results at the matching line.

preferences.name: showDetail
preferences.title: Results
preferences.label: Show details next to results
preferences.description: A preview and the matching passage beside the list.
